name: Node.js 20+
description: Node.js 20 or newer on this computer, for scripts that use fetch, node:crypto and ES modules.

spec.summary: Node.js 20 or newer. The toolkit scripts are plain Node with no dependencies to install.

instructions.*: Install Node.js 20 or newer from https://nodejs.org (an LTS release), or with a version manager (`mise use -g node@lts`, `fnm install --lts`, `nvm install --lts`). Open a new terminal and press **Check**.
instructions.darwin: `brew install node`, or a version manager: `mise use -g node@lts` / `fnm install --lts`. Open a new terminal and press **Check**.
instructions.linux: Use your distribution's `nodejs` package only if it is 20 or newer; otherwise a version manager (`mise use -g node@lts`, `fnm install --lts`) or https://nodejs.org. Open a new terminal and press **Check**.
instructions.windows: `winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS`, or the installer from https://nodejs.org. Open a new terminal and press **Check**.
